Frontend: full author flow (create→edit→delete with Catalan modal) PASS. AdminPage refactor smoke: all 4 sections render without errors. minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 ('Error actualitzant nota') instead of 404 when note_id does not exist. Root cause: supabase_py .single() raises an exception when zero rows match, which is caught by the bottom 'except Exception' clause before the explicit 404 HTTPException can fire. Fix: use .maybe_single() or .limit(1) and inspect data length before raising 404 / use .execute() instead of .single() and check len(result.data)==0.
Same .single() problem likely returns 500 instead of 404 on non-existent note (not directly tested but identical code shape at routers/cases.py:448).

critical_code_review_comments: BUG (fixed): DetailPanel.js was using <Trash> phosphor icon (lines 263 + 393) without importing it. Would have crashed every note rendered for the author. Already added to import.

BUG (open): routers/cases.py PUT/DELETE /notes/{id} use `.single().execute()` which throws on 0-rows; the explicit `raise HTTPException(404)` is unreachable, so 404 is masked as 500. The bare `except Exception` swallows the underlying postgrest error.

rca_of_the_issue.trash_icon_missing_import: DetailPanel.js imported phosphor icons explicitly but Trash was added to JSX (lines 263, 393) without updating the import. Symptom would be a runtime ReferenceError on note hover/delete-modal render only for note authors. Fixed by adding Trash to the import list.
rca_of_the_issue.put_404_returns_500: supabase-py .single() on a SELECT with 0 rows raises postgrest.exceptions.APIError instead of returning data=None. The existing logic `if not existing.data: raise 404` is unreachable. Mitigation: use `.execute()` and inspect `result.data` length, or wrap in a specific PostgrestAPIError handler that maps PGRST116 → 404.
